story_fits.chapter: 3 finale, ep 30 TWIST (Day 10/80, Fri 27 Nov Black Friday), Dubai lifestyle-trap theme
story_fits.scene: Black Friday in Bulawayo: Clyde is in a queue for 'the biggest game drop in 12 years' (never named, no logo, no characters), paying with the crew's train-ticket money for Victoria Falls. Cenzo finds him third in line with a camping chair. Clyde: 'I WAITED 12 YEARS. I CAN WAIT 12 HOURS.' As the shop opens, the person first in the queue turns around: a gold ring catches the light (the Collector, seen, never shown).
story_fits.lesson: Hype makes you spend money you already promised to something else.
story_fits.rule_line: WAITED 12 YEARS FOR A GAME. CAN'T WAIT 12 DAYS FOR PAYDAY.
story_fits.card:
BUY THE GAME
NOT THE DEBT
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'BET. PREORDERING PAYDAY.' then the gold ring at the front of the queue = TWIST cliffhanger.
story_fits.safety: No game name, logo, characters or footage on screen; caption may use #gta6 only because the episode is about game-drop hype.

story_fits.scene: Hidden behind the mango stall, Clyde can't stop reviewing the Collector's black car like a car influencer ('tinted windows, rims clean, villain spec'). Solo comes back: he handed the Collector his watch back, not the pages. The car drives off; Clyde waves goodbye to it.
story_fits.lesson: Don't admire the thing that's chasing you.
story_fits.technique: MISDIRECT (starts as a compliment, ends savage)
story_fits.button: Clyde: 'FIVE STARS. WOULD GET CHASED AGAIN.'
